description: The primary supply-chain analyst role for Northwind Logistics. Owns carrier on-time-delivery (OTD), lane cost benchmarks, fill rate, and quarterly carrier rebalancing reviews — the BETWEEN-warehouse axis of the operations data shape. Pairs with `warehouse-operations` (sister role; INSIDE-warehouse axis: inventory, picking, labor). Reads from `public.shipments` (12.3M-row fact) joined to `public.carriers`, `public.lanes`, `public.shippers`, `public.delivery_surveys`.
